description: Fetch the per-tool SDK marker (KO-10) of an EXISTING tool by software_id. Embed it via the build env var CRELA_SDK_MARKER before uploading a new build with update_software. For a tool that does not exist yet use preview_marker (needs slug, not software_id). Requires CRELA_API_KEY.
name: get_sdk_marker
title: Get the Crela SDK marker for an existing tool
